title: SSC CGL Tier-I 2026 pattern — original practice pack (Batch 2)

pattern_baseline.target_year_note: The 2027 CGL notice was not available on 2026-11-08. This pack follows the latest verifiable official 2026 Tier-I scheme and is labelled as a 2026-pattern baseline for 2027 preparation. It must be re-checked when the 2027 notice is published.

provenance.pyq_statement: Every question is original ExamEdge practice written to the official 2026 Tier-I syllabus and pattern. No question is copied from, reconstructed from, or presented as an SSC previous-year paper, official paper, shift or final answer key.
provenance.translation: English and Hindi question/option text is provided for app parity. The Hindi text is an ExamEdge translation, not an official SSC translation. The notice states that Tier-I questions are set in English and Hindi except English Comprehension; the English Comprehension Hindi text here is a study aid only.
provenance.authoring_note: Batch 2 is a second, independent 100-question pool. Quantitative answers are recomputed from independent expressions; factual items cite a source and an as-of date.

review.label: Practice • auto-checked • human review pending
review.publish_rule: Production publication requires a named human reviewer and the attestation flag. The import CLI keeps content in Draft by default and refuses to publish without --reviewer and --confirm-human-review.
known_limits: Automated checks verify structure, quotas, duplicates, option shape and recomputed quantitative answers. They do not replace subject-expert review of language, ambiguity, difficulty or factual framing.
No independent human review has been completed for this pack yet.
The 2027 official notice and its final answer keys are not available; nothing here is an official paper or key.

coverage_plan.full_mock: One additional complete Tier-I mock: 100 questions, 4 subjects x 25, +2 correct, -0.5 wrong, 60 minutes with four 15-minute subject locks, 200 screening marks.
coverage_plan.practice_sets: Together with Batch 1, this gives two independent full-mock pools and eight sectional papers. Topic-specific drills still need a larger reviewed pool.
